name: Gauge
summary: Gauge should get a cautious T1 public-surface pass focused on visible claims, access friction, pricing clarity, and proof depth.

claims.claim: Homepage loads without login and value proposition is visible
claims.evidence: "Be the Answer for AI" and "Unlock the millions of users exploring ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and more."

claims.claim: Primary agent capability is stated in concrete, testable terms
claims.evidence: "Gauge gives clear onsite and offsite recommendations to own your category."

claims.claim: Pricing or free/trial path is publicly discoverable
claims.evidence: Gauge offers three plans: Starter for $99/mo, Growth for $599/mo, and Enterprise with custom pricing.

claims.claim: Core workflow can be inspected from public docs, demo, templates, or repository
Trust, privacy, or data-handling claims are findable from public navigation
claims.evidence: "LEGAL / COMPLIANCE" and "Privacy Policy" links are present on the pricing page.

claims.claim: Competitor/differentiation claim is specific enough to verify
claims.evidence: "Gauge gives clear onsite and offsite recommendations to own your category."

claims.claim: Public surface exposes at least one realistic scenario for the review engine
claims.evidence: "Gauge gives clear onsite and offsite recommendations to own your category."
